=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/session-start.sh (and its .claude/ twin)
  Location: report_claude_assets_drift, the `paste -sd, -` line
  Issue: the hook relies on GNU `paste` being present; on a minimal container image without coreutils the function silently emits an empty `files=` because the `|| true` swallows the missing-binary error. Not reachable on Claude Code Web today, but a portable fallback (e.g. `tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/,$//'`) would keep the diagnostic useful in any environment that ships `timeout`.
  Suggested minimal fix: replace `paste -sd, -` with a `tr`/`sed` pipeline guarded by `command -v paste` (or always), 1–2 lines.
  Estimated lines changed: 1–2

- File: workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md (and .claude/ twin)
  Location: `### Claude-asset sync` step 4 merge command
  Issue: when the PR head has a local commit that the default branch has already absorbed, `git merge --no-ff origin/<source>` succeeds as a merge commit and `HEAD^1` exists — but if a future caller runs the same line on an already-up-to-date branch (no drift to merge, or the working tree's tip equals the source tip), Git refuses the no-op and `HEAD^1` becomes meaningless for the settings-detection step that follows. The text does not guard against this case; a pre-check `git fetch . origin/<source> <local>` and short-circuit when the branches are equal would prevent a misleading "settings.json changed" log entry.
  Suggested minimal fix: add one line after step 4 that bails out (or skips step 6) when the merge was a no-op, ≤2 lines.
  Estimated lines changed: 1–2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
